Name: Sprinkler Upgrader
Author: BluPenDragon
Description:
Dont toss out those old sprinklers, Upgrade them,
recipe from Clint
READ THE READ ME for instructions on how to select what recipes you want
Default
3 Basic Sprinklers = 1 Quality Sprinkler
3 Quality Sprinklers = 1 Iridium Sprinkler
5 Irridium Sprinklers = 1 Prismatic Sprinkler
OR
Rebalanced
1 Basic Sprinkler + 1 Gold bar = 1 Quality Sprinkler
1 Quality ﻿Sprinkler + 1 Battery = 1 Irridum Sprinkler
1 Irridum  Sprinkler + 1 Prismatic Bar = Prismatic Sprinkler

With the Optional release you can upgrade Geodes as well
1 Geode + 25 stone = 1 Frozen Geode
1 Frozen Geode + 25 stone = 1 Magma Geode
1 Magma Geode + 25 stone = 1 Omni Geode

Requires JsonAssets & ProducerFrameworkMod
Directions
1) Install SMAPI (if not already done)
2) Download required mods
3) Download this mod
4) extract all mods into your "Mods" folder
(located within your game folder)
5) Enjoy
